reply.text:
That sounds serious, and it's not something to wait out or handle with a coach. Call your local emergency number or poison control right now, or have someone take you to the nearest ER, and tell them what you took and how much if you know.

If you're alone, please reach out to someone near you so you're not by yourself. If you took them on purpose or you're having thoughts of hurting yourself, call or text 988 if you're in the US, or your local crisis line.

The training can wait. Please get help now.
